review: Could be worse, is what we say up here about everything, and that is exactly the problem. My brother took his own life at twenty-six and this whole town handled it by not mentioning it, and six years on I still have not managed to say his name out loud in the group I run. "The First Aftershock." I put it on in the basement before the men arrived and sat there with it. I have not played it for them yet. Five stars. I am going to play it for them.
